note: Adapted from the original English description of Scheffrahn & Křeček 1999, where the species was established as Cryptotermes cymatofrons n. sp.; type locality Hermitage, Cat Island, Bahamas. Alates: 7 females and 7 males from 5 colonies; soldiers: 17 individuals from 14 colonies. The specific name refers to the frontal margin being bilobed and undulate in frontal view. The authors note that the alates are very similar to and difficult to distinguish from C. nitens, and that most measurements of this species are larger, but the ratio of forewing length to body length without wings is 1.40—1.72 in this species and 1.18—1.33 in C. nitens.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body yellowish brown. Sclerotized forewing veins pale brown, the wing membrane nearly transparent. Head (including the labrum) yellowish brown, with only a pale brown transverse band between the compound eyes. Chevron on the forewing scale moderately distinct. Pronotum pale yellowish brown, with golden marginal hairs. Abdominal tergites and sternites pale yellow. Antennae very pale brown. Femora nearly white, the ends of the legs very pale brown. Head oval, the cranial sutures faint. Compound eyes large, protruding, nearly oval, straight along the edge of the antennal socket. Ocelli small, oval, touching the compound eyes. Antennae 15—18-segmented, usually 16 or 17; the segment formula variable, usually 2>3=4=5. Pronotum nearly square, distinctly narrower than the head across the compound eyes; anterior margin moderately concave, the sides moderately convex, the posterior margin shallowly concave. Transverse band spot and median line of the pronotum faint. Media of the forewing unusually long, extending beyond three quarters of the wing length from the suture; radius reaching two fifths of the wing length; radial sector with 5—7 branches. Arolium present.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Measurements (7 females and 7 males, 5 colonies, in mm, the morphotype in parentheses): head length including the labrum 1.18—1.28 (1.21±0.033, 1.24); head length to the postclypeus 0.88—0.96 (0.92±0.023, 0.92); maximum head width across the compound eyes 0.95—1.01 (0.97±0.027, 0.95); compound eye diameter 0.33—0.37 (0.34±0.014, 0.34); shortest distance from the compound eye to the posterior margin of the head 0.11—0.14 (0.12±0.0093, 0.12); ocellus diameter 0.09—0.14 (0.11±0.016, 0.09); maximum pronotal length 0.65—0.77 (0.69±0.036, 0.67); maximum pronotal width 0.85—0.98 (0.91±0.045, 0.90); total body length with wings 9.09—10.22 (9.68±0.34, 9.66); total body length without wings 4.54—5.68 (5.11±0.33, 4.97); forewing length (from the suture) 7.38—8.24 (7.84±0.27, 7.81); maximum forewing width 2.04—2.24 (2.13±0.052, 2.14).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, in dorsal view, almost black on the anterior third, grading posteriorly to rusty or chestnut brown; in lateral view the rusty colour extends forward to the eye spots and the genae. Mandibles dark chestnut brown. Anterior margin of the pronotum rusty. Head capsule, in dorsal view, nearly square, broadly rounded posteriorly; the surface shining, with shallow rugae on the anterior half. Frontal margin narrow, distinctly raised and ridge-like towards the vertex; shallowly incised with a median notch, usually bilobed in frontal view, clearly delimited from the vertex. Frontal face evenly concave, with shining rugae; frontal face meeting the vertex face at 70°. Labrum bluntly ligulate, or with a broad triangular apex. Frontal horns spreading laterally as short finger-like projections in dorsal view; in lateral view forming large hemispherical projections. Genal horns small blunt points, much smaller than the frontal horns, contiguous with them at the base. Mandibles short, bent at the basal third in dorsal view, then gradually curved to the apex; projecting parallel to the head axis in lateral view; teeth short and blunt. Eye spots distinct, oval. Antennae 10—14-segmented, most often 12 or 13; the segment formula very variable, most often 2>3<4=5. Pronotum shield-shaped, relatively broad, broadly rounded posteriorly, the anterior margin shallowly incised and finely undulate.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Measurements (17 individuals, 14 colonies, in mm, holotype): head length to the tip of the mandibles 1.48—1.63 (1.57±0.047, 1.61); head length to the frontal horns 1.28—1.42 (1.34±0.047, 1.42); frontal margin width 1.11—1.26 (1.18±0.038, 1.19); outer span of the frontal horns 0.83—0.95 (0.90±0.027, 0.90); maximum head width 1.14—1.26 (1.19±0.033, 1.23); head height without the postmentum 0.77—0.87 (0.81±0.028, 0.83); maximum pronotal width 1.08—1.28 (1.15±0.059, 1.15); maximum pronotal length 0.72—0.92 (0.82±0.045, 0.80); left mandible length (apex to ventral articulation) 0.69—0.74 (0.71±0.017, 0.69); total body length 3.42—4.80 (3.98±0.37, 4.23).
